interest: Japan's full dry docks in 1940 strand a U.S. ship.
overview: Grew's April 1940 telegram on the disabled West Cusseta, towed to Yokohama, where dry docks were full.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a telegram regarding the availability of dry dock facilities in Yokohama for the disabled ship West Cusseta.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's telegram No. 260 on dry docks for the West Cusseta, 1940.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet on Dry Dock Facilities for the West Cusseta

subfiles.about: Ambassador Grew reports on the arrival of the disabled West Cusseta in Yokohama and the shortage of dry dock facilities in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports the rudderless West Cusseta towed into Yokohama; docks were full, so agents considered towing it to Shanghai.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 260 from Ambassador Grew to the Secretary of State
